line.name: Gold Label
line.binder: Connecticut Broadleaf and Connecticut Shade (dual binder)
line.background_text: Gold Label debuted at the 2024 PCA Trade Show as part of Rocky Patel's newer 'precious metals and stones'-themed lineup, positioned as a more affordable, approachable option relative to his premium-tier blends. It pairs an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper with a dual Connecticut binder over Nicaraguan long fillers, and is made at Tabacalera Villa Cuba S.A. in Esteli, Nicaragua.

vitolas.summary_review: Halfwheel found the Toro an easy-drinking but uncomplex 'session cigar' with toast, leather, black pepper and coffee notes; a later aged-sample redux review rated it higher for added complexity, and Cigar Coop rated it similarly, noting a sour, unripe-raisin note in the final third.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Original review found toastiness/terroir-dominant flavors of burnt toast, leather, black pepper and coffee, calling it a consistent but uncomplex 'session cigar' lasting roughly 2.5-3+ hours.
A redux review of an aged sample noted woodiness, potato, Worcestershire-like savoriness, cardamom, honey, graham cracker and creamy bread retrohales, with improved complexity versus the fresh cigar.
Rated 'Try a Sample' with cocoa, raisin, earth, cedar, mineral and pepper notes; strong first two-thirds followed by a sour, unripe-raisin quality in the final third.
